package.name: diy_localization
package.description: Localization stack for DIY Challenge 2026. Wraps FAST-LIO2 (LiDAR-inertial odometry), a single robot_localization EKF (wheel + IMU angular-rate + gated lidar odometry -> /odometry/filtered), and map_localizer (VGICP relocalization against a saved map -> map->odom TF) into a single launch file. Also provides the LIO-SAM offline mapping launch for prior map generation.
